title: Her piano lessons and trying Bunk's trumpet
summary: She took piano lessons briefly with Mrs. Florence Pemberton, tried Bunk's trumpet for a few months, and helped him with notes and horn care.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees
